rule.fail_rule: MIRI_FAIL iff a run reported undefined behaviour at the site's (file, line); the site cites the run id
rule.not_reachable_rule: MIRI_NOT_REACHABLE iff no committed harness executed the site; it is not a clean result
rule.pass_rule: MIRI_PASS iff the site's file is covered by a passing harness (the modules its source calls into) and its operation is not a foreign/asm boundary; the site cites the run id and the run's command hash
rule.unsupported_rule: MIRI_UNSUPPORTED iff the site is a foreign/asm boundary Miri cannot execute or is on the unsupported surface a run observed a foreign-function refusal on; the reason is recorded
